newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan seen auctioning 4-yr notes,T-bills next week.
newsitem.headline: Japan seen auctioning 4-yr notes,T-bills next week.

text.p: Japan's Ministry of Finance (MOF) is likely to offer four-year government notes and six-month Treasury bills next week through price-competitive auctions, bond traders said on Wednesday.
They said new six-month Treasury bills (T-bills) are expected to be issued as 1.4 trillion yen worth of six-month T-bills are maturing on February 10.
MOF last auctioned four-year notes on December 3, when it offered 500 billion yen worth of the medium-term notes at a record low coupon rate of 1.2 percent.
